facts.text: LaGrange College offers its Study-Away Commitment to help fund off-campus travel experiences at the end of the sophomore or junior year, offering grants up to $2,000.

sources.title: Study-Away Commitment - LaGrange College
sources.quote: LaGrange's Study-Away Commitment encourages you to go beyond the walls of the classroom and helps pay for an off-campus travel experience at the end of your sophomore or junior year. Grants of up to $2000 are available to help with expenses.
